medicalPromo.headline:
Medical programmes
−25 %
medicalPromo.teaserText: On 22 September the 25 % discount on medical programmes in Marienbad opens. Choose any stay between 15 October 2026 and 30 June 2027.
medicalPromo.saleText: Until 30 September only: book your medical stay in Marienbad with 25 % off. Healthy In, Traditional Spa or Immunity Booster — with arrival any time up to the end of June 2027.
medicalPromo.footnote: Booking window: 22–30 Sept 2026 • Stay 15 Oct 2026 – 30 June 2027
medicalPromo.landingPageTitle: Medical programmes with 25 % off — Marienbad — Marienbad.com
medicalPromo.landingPageDescription: 25 % off medical programmes at the Ensana hotels in Marienbad. Book 22–30 September 2026 for stays from 15 October 2026 to 30 June 2027.
medicalPromo.programmesIntro: The 25 % discount applies to every Ensana medical programme. For Marienbad we particularly recommend these three.

programmes.name: Healthy In
programmes.description: A shorter medical stay for a first encounter with the Marienbad cure — an initial medical consultation, treatments matched to your needs and the drinking cure from the local springs.

programmes.name: Traditional Spa
programmes.description: The classic comprehensive cure in the form Marienbad has passed down for more than two hundred years. Medical supervision, daily treatments and natural healing resources.

programmes.name: Immunity Booster
programmes.description: A programme built around strengthening your defences before winter, combining the natural mineral springs, carbon dioxide baths and walking in the spa forests.

medicalPromo.expiredNotice: The Medical Promo booking window closed on 30 September 2026. Current offers from the Ensana hotels in Marienbad are on their website.
